notes: ABox revision of a derived fact: the largest amphitheatre in Rome becomes the Verona Arena. Same shape as the geography template: the Colosseum is the largest in the world and stands in Rome, so 'the largest in Rome is the Colosseum' follows from two premises every model states, while the direct form is almost never written. The new object has stored neighbours the edit overturns (it is in Verona, in Veneto), through has_largest_amphitheatre and largest_amphitheatre_of (a subproperty of located_in). Worlds: the Colosseum leaves Rome (w1) or stops being the largest in the world (w2); lopsided, kept unweighted. The indeterminate query asks the largest amphitheatre in the world (derived_beliefs); under w1 it keeps the Colosseum, so a model that never propagated the edit also matches w1, and w1 matches should be read together with the direct and premise-route answers. The related question is the stored location of the Arena, which the edit moves into Rome. Caveats: the Arena's name says where it is, so its location questions are partly answerable from the name; the direct form 'largest amphitheatre in Rome' has 29 and 50 hits, close to the premise sentence (73), so the fact may be stored rather than derived.
